tagline: The crown of the hero chain — Komodo, Flores and Sumba.
summary: Labuan Bajo is the gateway to Komodo National Park and the Flores–Sumba coast — the climactic end of the Bali → Lombok → Komodo → Sumba luxury chain. It is a high-value, low-infrastructure region where silent, smooth, low-wake foiling fits both the protected marine park and the premium-charter market.

competitive_landscape: Access is by wooden phinisi liveaboards and fast boats from Labuan Bajo — characterful but slow, weather-dependent and conventional. The park is a protected conservation jewel where low-wake, low-impact craft are increasingly demanded, and the long chain legs to Lombok and Sumba have no fast premium link today.
seasonality: The dry season (Apr–Oct) is best; the wet season (Nov–Mar) brings rougher seas. Komodo's straits are windy and current-swept in Jul–Aug. Foiling improves comfort, and Quanta-LR range carries the long chain legs across seasons.
regulatory_note: Komodo National Park enforces conservation fees and visitor management; sea transport falls under Indonesia's Directorate of Sea Transportation — both favour low-impact, low-wake, zero-emission craft.

precedents.why_it_matters: The at-scale playbook for clean luxury island-hopping — the crown of the hero chain can adopt it.
